description: A null string is equal to the null keyword
notes: The spec says equal values must have identical types, and the null keyword has the dynamic pseudo-type, which is identical only to itself, so the result should be false (read literally, the comparison operator rule for operands of the dynamic pseudo-type would even make it unknown). hashicorp/hcl returns true because go-cty treats any two nulls as equal regardless of type (Value.Equals in cty/value_ops.go). Inside a tuple the types are compared (equality-nested-null-string-and-null-keyword).
